definitions.explanation: Curiosity or attention directed toward something.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}に{興味|きょうみ}がある。
examples.notes: 〜に{興味|きょうみ}がある pattern

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{歴史|れきし}に{興味|きょうみ}を{持|も}った。
examples.english: I became interested in Japanese history.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}のポスターに{興味|きょうみ}を{引|ひ}かれた。
examples.english: I was drawn to that movie's poster.
examples.notes: {興味|きょうみ}を{引|ひ}く = to attract interest

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{勧|すす}められて{興味|きょうみ}を{持|も}ったが、やってみたら{本当|ほんとう}に{面白|おもしろ}かった。
examples.english: A friend recommended it and I got interested, and when I tried it, it was really fun.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}は{虫|むし}にしか{興味|きょうみ}がなかったが、{大|おお}きくなってからは{色々|いろいろ}なことに{興味|きょうみ}を{持|も}つようになった。
examples.english: When I was a child I was only interested in insects, but as I grew up I became interested in many things.

notes:
{興味|きょうみ} means 'interest' (in the sense of curiosity).

Key patterns:
- 〜に{興味|きょうみ}がある: to be interested in ~
- 〜に{興味|きょうみ}を{持|も}つ: to take an interest in ~
- {興味|きょうみ}{深|ぶか}い: deeply interesting

Note: {興味|きょうみ} is interest as curiosity, not financial interest ({利子|りし}/{利息|りそく}).

Common collocations:
- {興味|きょうみ}がわく: interest arises
- {興味|きょうみ}を{引|ひ}く: to attract interest
- {興味|きょうみ}を{失|うしな}う: to lose interest
